import.spiegazione:
A sheet with a Habit column can hold many of them; otherwise each sheet is one habit and its name becomes the title. The check-in dates are needed, and ideally the time.
I recognise the columns by name: if I get it wrong, you can fix it after the upload.

import.pi_hint:

I recognise them by name; if they're missing I use the standard positions.

lp.nota_hero: Free · Italian and English · Works offline

lp.f_progetti_p: Break a goal into sub-projects, work in focused sessions and see where your time really goes.
lp.f_flashcard_p: Create cards in minutes, review them at the right moment and let the AI tutor explain what you got wrong.
lp.f_lingue_p: Vocabulary with meanings and examples: typed in, pasted from Excel or generated with AI.
lp.f_studio_p: Decide what to study and when, log your exams and keep an eye on your average.
lp.f_abitudini_p: Habit rings, streaks worth keeping and medicine reminders, with a log of every dose.
lp.f_diario_p: Write about your day, track your mood and energy, and look back over past weeks.
lp.f_liste_p: Things to do and to buy, with priorities and categories. Anything with a date shows up in your calendar too.
lp.social_p: Soon you'll be able to add friends, see how they're doing and challenge each other on Pomodoros and streaks.
lp.ovunque_t: On your phone, like a real app.
lp.ovunque_p: Add it to your Home Screen and it opens full screen. No app store, nothing to install, and whatever you do offline is sent as soon as you're back online.
